name: Dal Baati Churma
description: Iconic Rajasthani platter — crispy baked wheat balls served with panchmel dal and sweet churma. The soul of Rajasthani cuisine.

name: Laal Maas
description: Fiery Rajasthani mutton curry slow-cooked with mathania red chilies, garlic, and traditional spices.

name: Gatte Ki Sabzi
description: Steamed gram flour dumplings simmered in a tangy yogurt-based curry with desert spices.

name: Ker Sangri
description: Traditional desert delicacy made with dried berries and beans, tempered with red chilies and mango powder.

name: Papad Ki Sabzi
description: Unique Rajasthani curry made with roasted papad pieces in a spicy yogurt gravy.

name: Mirchi Vada
description: Jodhpur's famous street snack — large green chilies stuffed with spiced potato and deep-fried in gram flour batter.

name: Pyaaz Kachori
description: Crispy, flaky pastry shells stuffed with spiced onion filling, served with tangy tamarind chutney.

name: Dal Ki Pakodi
description: Crunchy lentil fritters made with moong dal and spices, a perfect tea-time snack.

name: Mawa Kachori
description: Sweet pastry filled with rich mawa (khoya) and dry fruits, drizzled with sugar syrup. A Jodhpuri specialty.

name: Ghevar
description: Traditional Rajasthani disc-shaped sweet cake made with flour and soaked in sugar syrup, topped with rabri.

name: Malpua
description: Sweet pancakes made with flour, milk, and cardamom, deep-fried and dipped in sugar syrup with rabri.

name: Churma Ladoo
description: Crumbled wheat balls mixed with ghee, jaggery, and dry fruits — shaped into traditional ladoos.

name: Bajre Ki Roti
description: Rustic millet flatbread cooked on an open flame, served with a generous dollop of white butter.

name: Missi Roti
description: Flavorful flatbread made with a mix of wheat and gram flour, seasoned with onions, green chilies, and spices.

name: Masala Chai
description: Aromatic spiced tea brewed with ginger, cardamom, cloves, and fresh milk — served in a kulhad.

name: Lassi
description: Thick, creamy buttermilk churned with curd, served sweet or salted in a traditional matka glass.

name: Jaljeera
description: Refreshing cumin-mint cooler with tamarind and black salt — the perfect Rajasthani thirst quencher.

name: Rajasthani Thali
description: A grand platter featuring dal baati churma, gatte ki sabzi, ker sangri, bajre ki roti, papad, pickle, and sweet.
